title: Import Apify dataset results into HubSpot

hubspotAccessToken.title: HubSpot access token
hubspotAccessToken.description: Your HubSpot access token. Works with both private app tokens (from Settings > Integrations > Private Apps) and OAuth access tokens.

datasetId.title: Dataset
datasetId.description: Apify dataset to import. 'contacts' mode reads leadsEnrichment[] rows per company; 'company' mode reads Contact Details Scraper items (emails, phones, social profiles) per company website.

importMode.title: Import mode
importMode.description: 'contacts': each dataset item's leadsEnrichment[] rows are imported as HubSpot contacts associated to the company. 'company': cleaned contact details from the company's website are written onto the HubSpot company record.

companyUrlMapping.title: Company URL to HubSpot ID mapping
companyUrlMapping.description: Map company URLs to their HubSpot company IDs. Dataset items are matched via the 'originalStartUrl' field.

companyId.title: HubSpot company ID
companyId.description: The HubSpot company ID that matched leads should be associated with.

dataMappings.title: Field mappings
dataMappings.description: Map source fields to HubSpot properties. In 'contacts' mode 'source' is a leadsEnrichment field (e.g. 'email', 'firstName') and 'target' a contact property. In 'company' mode 'source' is one of companyEmail, companyPhone, companyLinkedIn, companyX, companyFacebook, companyInstagram, companyYouTube, companyTikTok and 'target' a company property (companyX → 'twitterhandle' is written as the bare handle).

source.title: Source field
source.description: Source field key: a leadsEnrichment field in 'contacts' mode (e.g. 'email', 'jobTitle'), or a company source in 'company' mode (e.g. 'companyLinkedIn').

target.title: HubSpot property
target.description: Internal name of an existing HubSpot property: a contact property in 'contacts' mode (e.g. 'firstname'), a company property in 'company' mode (e.g. 'linkedin_company_page').

overwriteMode.title: When already set
overwriteMode.description: 'overwrite' replaces the existing HubSpot value; 'skip' leaves the existing value untouched when it is non-empty. Defaults to 'overwrite' if omitted.

deduplication.title: Deduplication key
deduplication.description: Contacts mode only. Existing-contact lookup key. 'email' matches on the HubSpot 'email' property; 'phone' matches on 'phone'. Leads missing the chosen value are skipped.

onlyVerifiedEmails.title: Only verified emails
onlyVerifiedEmails.description: Contacts mode only. When enabled, only leads whose emailVerification.result is 'ok' are imported. Requires the enrichment actor to have email verification enabled (verifyLeadsEnrichmentEmails).
